eligible.description: false only for draft, closed, already-reviewed-at-this-SHA, or a release-please style automated PR with no hand-written change

skip_reason.description: One line. Required when eligible is false, null otherwise.

tier.description: Advisory label for the run log. lenses is what actually drives the matrix.

summary.description: What this change does, in the terms the author intended. 3-6 sentences.

must_verify.description: Specific claims a reviewer must check to believe this change is safe. Each is a falsifiable statement, not a topic. Never a claim already recorded in settled.

settled.description: Findings from earlier rounds of this gate that the author has answered on the pull request: fixed in the tree, or declined with a stated reason. Empty on a first review.

answer.description: How the author answered it, naming the reply or the commit that did.

rereview.description: true when this gate has already posted a verdict on an earlier commit of this pull request.
